answer: A durable way to resist sybils is to make identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate or fraudulent behavior. Like an umber pigment that only deepens when mixed with a real binder, reputation should only strengthen through verifiable work over time, not through sheer numbers. A single ember of genuine, attested service history should outweigh a thousand freshly minted shells, because creating each shell then costs stake, time, and forfeited collateral rather than just a new keypair.
